articles.title: Chiefs' Mahomes has surgery for torn ACL, LCL
articles.summary: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes underwent successful surgery Monday in Dallas to repair the tear in his left ACL. A league source told ESPN that Mahomes also had a torn LCL that was repaired.

articles.title: Source: Jags' Tuten out weeks for finger surgery
